lines.voice: Maa hamesha kehti thi... mujhe bhookh nahi hai.
lines.caption: Maa always said she wasn't hungry.
lines.sub: माँ हमेशा कहती थी... मुझे भूख नहीं है।

lines.voice: Rotiyan chaar banti thin. Hum teen the.
lines.caption: Four rotis were made. There were three of us.
lines.sub: रोटियाँ चार बनती थीं। हम तीन थे।

lines.voice: Woh pehle hamein khilati thi. Phir kehti... main baad mein kha loongi.
lines.caption: She fed us first. Then she'd say, "I'll eat later."
lines.sub: वो पहले हमें खिलाती थी। फिर कहती... मैं बाद में खा लूँगी।

lines.caption: It took me years to understand.

lines.voice: Usse bhookh nahi thi... usse bas hamara pet bharna tha.
lines.caption: She wasn't hungry. She just wanted us full.
lines.sub: उसे भूख नहीं थी... उसे बस हमारा पेट भरना था।

lines.voice: Maa ne kabhi kaha nahi... par maine sab sun liya.
lines.caption: Maa never said it. But I heard everything.
lines.sub: माँ ने कभी कहा नहीं... पर मैंने सब सुन लिया।
